title: Spanish Honeyed Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, incorporating honeyed notes. Perfect for a warm evening with friends.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: for a sweet and savory flavor

ingredients.name: Honeyed
ingredients.notes: use as a substitute for some of the regular honey

ingredients.name: Paella seasoning
ingredients.notes: available at most Spanish markets or online

instructions: Heat a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 tbsp of honey and 2 tbsp of honeyed; stir until fragrant.
Add crunchy vegetables and cook until tender.
Add Spanish rice and stir to coat with the honey mixture.
Add paella seasoning and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with lemon wedges, if desired.
